author: Independent read-only reviewer /root/functional_audit
conditions: Freeze a clean source checkpoint containing these exact bytes; re-review any changed reviewed bytes. Existing full helper supervisor/auditor receipts must independently match their frozen source digest.

This audit covers functional callback, RPC transport/repair integration and load primitive only; it does not grant full helper supervisor/auditor approval or approve an unwritten load application caller.
Use fresh synthetic disposable domains, pinned retained amd64 image/archive, protected staging/evaluator domains and one native operation at a time.
Require independent outer cleanup receipt plus current process/cgroup/socket/container inventory after each run; preserve partial and failed evidence and stop if ownership unresolved.

Load gate remains deferred until a separately reviewed application setup/phase caller and artifact prerequisites exist. This audit claims no installation, rollback, reproduction, load or recovery gate completion.
findings: Functional callback executes under source-bound native_driver.execute owned acceptance and existing whole-operation provisioning lease; actual admitted manifest/image state rejects failed_startup_barrier before socket retirement and compares exact socket identity plus verified live environment.

RPC probes require immutable already-loaded image without anonymous volumes; synthetic containers use owned Journal authority, disabled network and bounded resources. Only declared create/start operation is proxied.
Lost-ACK reach requires independently retained actual successful daemon HTTP 201 for create and 204 for start, with response_delivered false; CLI failure alone is insufficient.

Proxy close joins executor and verifies all inventoried descriptors closed before repair. If proxy cleanup cannot prove quiescence, Journal cleanup is withheld and outer whole-daemon cleanup remains mandatory.

Operational repair checks exact context fingerprint, proof filename/schema/attempt, old epoch and positive whole-daemon/worker barrier, new durable epoch and current verified environment. Repeated Journal cleanup is revalidated against the same resolution.

Callback receipt never constitutes final acceptance: native_driver independently loads current refreshed manifest, runs shutdown barrier before uncertain-client cancellation and finalizes only after cleanup_complete. External current-resource inspection remains separately required.

Load adapter reuses existing 300-second schedule and thresholds with explicit injected request opener; private opener disables proxies and redirects. Original staging default request behavior remains unchanged.

Load health checks require exact loaded image/container ID, running state, owned worker parent, exclusively IPv4 loopback published bindings and matching TCP endpoint. Reviewed caller must supply phase_guard covering fresh DB/epoch/queue/worker identities. Host resource floor and partial observations are retained.
Load source tests cover foreign bindings, invalid origins and actual local redirect refusal without forwarding synthetic bearer; inspected source tests are not native execution evidence.
